entry.title: Binaural Echo 1.0.0
entry.summary: A 3D headphone panner. Place any track around your head with Q-Links for azimuth, elevation and distance, or let it orbit, swing or fly by on its own, free or tempo-synced. Echoes travel round the head as they repeat. Head-model, ambisonic and lightweight modes, with air absorption and a small room. **Features** - Azimuth, elevation, distance and mix on the first four Q-Links, with 3D wireframe tiles that follow the sound - Three render modes: Head (a parametric head model), Field (first-order a
